newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares end firm, more gains expected.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares end firm, more gains expected.

text.p: Austrian shares ended the week on a buoyant note as the smooth expiry of April futures and options contracts sparked a buying spree that lifted the key ATX index over one percent higher.

The ATX of 21 blue chips ended the day up 12.45 points or 1.06 percent at 1,191.93, bringing its total gain over the week to 2.4 percent. Among its constituents, 13 winners outnumbered seven decliners, one issue was unchanged.
Traders said they expected the market to continue trading with a positive bias over the coming week and that a fresh attack on 1,200 points in the ATX was well within reach.
"It certainly looks like it's going to be friendly next week," said one.
Market heavyweight OMV, the energy and chemicals group, topped the day's winners. The share rose 2.88 percent to close at 1,319.90 schillings.
Mayr-Melnhof Karton remained under pressue ahead of the release of first-quarter figures scheduled for next Thursday, falling 1.66 percent to 585.
Brick-maker Wienerberger Baustoffindustrie, due to detail 1996 results next Tuesday, rose 44 schillings to 2,189.

On the Austrian futures and options exchange, ATX contracts for May delivery rose 17.4 points to 1,185.0 on turnover of 1,267 contracts. The April future expired 7.7 points higher at 1,181.8. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12256
